_comment: One truth table for 'is the vault open?', shared by every adapter that answers it.
The rules live here because they are duplicated by construction: bash decides in
securetrash/lib/common.sh (_volume_mounted), the macOS menu-bar app in Swift
(vaultVerdict) and the Windows tray in PowerShell (Get-PtVaultState). Nothing forces
three separate implementations to agree, and the one time they drifted the GUI showed a
green OPEN over a closed vault (AUDIT_2026-08-03 P2-10). Audit 2026-09-07 §16.3 asks for
the same scenarios checked in every adapter rather than for a rewrite of working GUIs.
Each rule is abstract evidence plus the verdict it must produce. A suite maps the evidence
onto its own mocks; test/state-contract.bats then checks that EVERY rule id is exercised
in EVERY adapter's suite, so a rule added here cannot stay unchecked anywhere.

verdicts.open: the volume is mounted right now and holds decrypted data
verdicts.closed: the container exists and is demonstrably not mounted
verdicts.none: there is no container at this path
verdicts.unknown: the answer could not be established - never to be shown as 'closed'

rules.evidence: the system's volume table lists the vault mount point
rules.why: the only evidence that actually means open: data is reachable now

rules.evidence: the mount point exists as a directory, but the volume table does not list it
rules.why: ejecting leaves the folder behind; treating the leftover as OPEN was P2-10

rules.evidence: the volume table cannot be read (no tool, empty output, an exception)
rules.why: a green 'closed' over an open vault is the worst possible lie; say we do not know

rules.evidence: the container file itself is absent
rules.why: nothing to open is a different answer from closed, and it needs a different offer

rules.evidence: the container is attached but locked or not encrypted at all
rules.why: attached is not open: a failed unlock leaves it locked, a died create leaves plaintext
no ground to raise the warning glyph or a notification, and no ground to hide it in the menu
